header:
# Town of Randolph municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 19; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

White River Valley Herald, 'Randolph Keeps Meeting, Passes Budgets' (March 5, 2026): the town's March 2026 outcomes (newspaper source, disclosed; the town posts no 2026 results) -- Kelly Green was re-elected Moderator, unopposed
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Town of Randolph, 2024 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS and APPOINTMENTS tables (a 2024 article to convert the Town Clerk to an appointed office was debated and not passed; the clerk remains elected): Tammy Munyon is Town Clerk; the seat did not stand in 2026
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Tammy Munyon as Randolph's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer

Town of Randolph, 2024 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS and APPOINTMENTS tables (a 2024 article to convert the Town Clerk to an appointed office was debated and not passed; the clerk remains elected): Tammy Munyon is Town Treasurer; the seat did not stand in 2026
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Tammy Munyon as Randolph's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Randolph's five selectboard members: Emery Mattheis, Alissa Matthews, Larry Satkowitz, Bethany Silloway, and Stephanie Tyler (the directory's name columns are swapped for Tyler)

White River Valley Herald, 'Randolph Keeps Meeting, Passes Budgets' (March 5, 2026): the town's March 2026 outcomes (newspaper source, disclosed; the town posts no 2026 results) -- Emery Mattheis won the three-year seat (480-460 over Ashley Lincoln) and Bethany Silloway won the two-year seat (514-418 over Dustin Adams); Alissa Matthews, Larry Satcowitz, and Stephanie Tyler continue

offices.title: Lister
offices.org_name: Town of Randolph Board of Listers

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three on staggered three-year terms

Town of Randolph, 2024 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS and APPOINTMENTS tables (a 2024 article to convert the Town Clerk to an appointed office was debated and not passed; the clerk remains elected): lister Mimi Burstein serves to 2027. Dennis Brown's seat expired in 2025 with no published outcome, and the 2026 three-year race had no declared candidate (a write-in leader is not seated on a plurality alone); two seats are unfilled

offices.title: Trustee of Public Funds
offices.org_name: Town of Randolph Trustees of Public Funds

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect trustees of public funds

Town of Randolph, 2024 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS and APPOINTMENTS tables (a 2024 article to convert the Town Clerk to an appointed office was debated and not passed; the clerk remains elected): trustees Joyce Mazzucco and Clifford Rankin; Bruce Butler's seat expired in 2025 with no published outcome (unfilled)

White River Valley Herald, 'Randolph Keeps Meeting, Passes Budgets' (March 5, 2026): the town's March 2026 outcomes (newspaper source, disclosed; the town posts no 2026 results) -- Clifford Rankin was re-elected Trustee of Public Funds in 2026

offices.title: Library Trustee
offices.org_name: Kimball Public Library Board of Trustees

sources.note: Town of Randolph, 2024 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS and APPOINTMENTS tables (a 2024 article to convert the Town Clerk to an appointed office was debated and not passed; the clerk remains elected): the Kimball Library trustees are five: Heather Bowman, Karen Lowry Reed, Edward Rooney, Morgan James Eaton, and Margaret 'Peg' Maupin

White River Valley Herald, 'Randolph Keeps Meeting, Passes Budgets' (March 5, 2026): the town's March 2026 outcomes (newspaper source, disclosed; the town posts no 2026 results) -- Morgan James Eaton won the three-year library seat (547-254) and Margaret Maupin won the one-year remainder seat

Town of Randolph, 2024 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS and APPOINTMENTS tables (a 2024 article to convert the Town Clerk to an appointed office was debated and not passed; the clerk remains elected): the Budget Committee has five seats elected from the floor of the annual meeting. The 2025 and 2026 floor outcomes are published in no official source, so the post is created without memberships

sources.note: Town of Randolph, 2024 Town Report, ELECTED OFFICIALS and APPOINTMENTS tables (a 2024 article to convert the Town Clerk to an appointed office was debated and not passed; the clerk remains elected): the APPOINTMENTS table styles the Town Manager as the appointed collector of delinquent taxes (temporary, early 2025).
